tools.name: find_matching_grants
tools.description: Find EU Horizon grants matching a description of your organisation or project. Returns top grants with budget, timeline, coordinator, and topic code. To score a specific consortium against any result, use calculate_score with org IDs from find_partners.

tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Full-text search across 27,000+ Horizon Europe projects. Returns ranked results with title, budget, start date, and an objective snippet.

tools.name: get_project_detail
tools.description: Returns full details for a single CORDIS project by RCN identifier, including budget, coordinator, top partners, and full objective.

tools.name: find_partners
tools.description: Suggests organisations with the most prior wins in a given research topic. Optionally filtered by country.

tools.name: calculate_score
tools.description: Scores a proposed consortium against a target Horizon Europe pillar using 6 evidence-based features (V1 — max 75/100). Returns score with full factor breakdown including keyword/topic overlap.

tools.name: find_open_calls
tools.description: PAID. Full-text search across all currently OPEN Horizon Europe calls (future deadline — still actionable, not yet applied to). Complements search_grants, which only covers past, already-funded projects. Ranked by relevance, filterable by pillar and days-to-deadline. Requires payment via x402; call
